verdict.rationale: Pulley's docs cover every instrument in the story: share-class configuration, customizable stock certificates, contract tabs for Shares, SAFEs, RSAs, RSUs and convertible notes, and option templates with plan capacity, vesting acceleration and termination handling. They also describe a live cap-table dashboard with complete history, as-of-date exports and transfer-agent status, which supports the single-source-of-truth claim. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of investor or auditor access to the live cap table (only ASC 718 reporting and audit-defensible 409As are shown), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
